result.summary: The page is generally usable, but there are a few visual polish issues: horizontal content is clipped at the right edge, some metadata text is low-contrast, and image-card action icons may be hard to see over artwork.

issues.description: Right-edge content is visibly cut off: the category row shows a partially clipped pill after “Healthy,” and the “Fastest near you” carousel truncates the third restaurant card/name (“Trattoria Piccol…”).
issues.suggestion: Add clearer horizontal-scroll affordance, edge fade, or adjust card widths/padding so partially visible items look intentional and restaurant names are not awkwardly truncated.

issues.description: Secondary metadata such as delivery fees, time ranges, and cuisine labels use small gray text that may be difficult to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Increase font size slightly and/or darken the gray to meet WCAG contrast guidance against the white background.

issues.description: Favorite heart icons are placed directly over dark/busy food imagery with only a thin outline, making the control boundary and state less obvious.
issues.suggestion: Give the favorite button a consistent circular background with sufficient contrast and a clearer selected/unselected state.

issues.description: The notification bell shows a red dot but no count or context, which can be ambiguous about whether there is a new notification or a persistent indicator.
issues.suggestion: Use a numeric badge when applicable or remove the dot when there are no actionable notifications.
